_source: Stamina economy per owner's rules: every run/attempt costs a fixed 5 stamina at 1x; 1 stamina / 6 min regen, +100/day from ads, diamond purchases 50/50/50/100/300/500 then 1000 each, +25 stamina per purchase. Default budget assumes purchases bought up to the 500 step (6 purchases). Waves per run are fixed by difficulty (owner-confirmed 2026-11): Hard 90, Hell/Abyss/Deep Sea 100.
